newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet ahead of U.S.data.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet ahead of U.S.data.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were little changed on Thursday as the market remained cautious ahead of U.S. durable goods data, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 1.09 points or 0.01 percent lower at 13,545.51 by 1300 GMT, after the Hang Seng in Hong Kong closed 4.77 points or 0.04 percent higher at 13,5446.60.
"There has been very little turnover today, with all sectors around Hong Kong's close," one trader said. "People are looking to Wall Street and durable goods data due out later."
